rationale: Correct Wecom's upstream ownership chain without treating GIC's 46.74% interest in Searchlight Fiber Alliance as a direct company-level percentage. Searchlight controls Wecom through the SFA, WCM Topco and WCM Holdco chain. GIC and ADIA hold insulated nonvoting interests in SFA, while Simple Broadband II and the founders retain minority Topco interests. Preserve one Wecom operating-company boundary and keep the exact GIC and ADIA entry dates as not publicly disclosed.

beforeImage.name: Wecom Fiber
beforeImage.description: Wecom Fiber is a broadband network platform serving residential and business customers in Arizona. Its end users are households, enterprises, and community institutions that require fiber-based internet access and communications services. The model is asset-heavy and contracted, with value supported by network buildout, customer relationships, and local market density. FCC materials tied to the ownership structure show that Searchlight Fiber Alliance and related entities control the investment vehicle around Wecom, and that GIC's Epsom Investment Pte. Ltd. held a 46.74% equity interest in the Searchlight Fiber Alliance structure in 2024. The reviewed materials did not disclose Wecom's revenue or the exact full capitalization of the broader sponsor structure. Searchlight invested in Wecom in 2023 and the ownership structure was subsequently reflected in FCC public notices.

afterImage.name: Wecom Fiber
afterImage.description: Wecom Fiber is the operating brand of Wecom LLC, an Arizona-based fiber broadband platform serving residential, business and community customers across eight Arizona counties and parts of Nevada. Searchlight Capital Partners controls the company through Searchlight Fiber Alliance, WCM Topco and WCM Holdco. GIC and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority hold insulated nonvoting interests in Searchlight Fiber Alliance rather than direct 46.74% stakes in Wecom; the FCC calculated each chain at 36.38% indirect Holdco equity. Simple Broadband II and the founders retain minority Topco interests. Public programs and private matching capital support a planned build to more than 66,000 premises, but customer and route-mile totals are not publicly disclosed. No later sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
